name: com.vk.orbit-camera
description:
Generic, near-zero-allocation orbiting showcase camera for Unity. Orbit an object with mouse, touch, or gamepad; zoom; and swap the focus object at runtime with smooth eased transitions. Built for vehicle configurators, product showcases, and real-estate walkarounds.

Requires LitMotion. Optional integrations: Unity Input System and Reflex DI (auto-detected).

samples.description: A runtime-built demo: orbit a few primitives, click/tap to refocus and auto-frame. No scene wiring required.
